annotations.title: Pendant light height and size calculator

description: Use when someone asks how high to hang a pendant or chandelier over a dining table or kitchen island, how long its drop should be, or what diameter of light suits a table or room.

fitting_height_cm.description: The shade’s own height, top to bottom (cm).

lights.description: Over a table: how many lights in a row (1–3).

place.description: table (over a table or island) or floor (over open floor or a hall).

room_length_cm.description: The room’s length, for the room-size rule (cm).

room_width_cm.description: The room’s width, for the room-size rule (cm).

name: pendant_light

bottom_from_floor_cm.description: The shade’s bottom from the floor

chandelier_height_cm.description: Table: a chandelier’s own height for this ceiling

diameter_cm.description: [low, high] shade size to choose (table: from its width; floor: the room rule)

drop_cm.description: Cord or rod, ceiling to the top of the shade; null if the shade does not fit

drop_range_cm.description: Table: the drop across the range

fits.description: The shade fits at that height

hang_above_table_cm.description: Table: the shade’s bottom above the table

hang_range_cm.description: Table: the range above the table

least_clear_cm.description: Floor: the least clearance one shop gives

overall_drop_cm.description: Table: ceiling to the bottom of the shade
